evaluations.result: identical input produces byte-identical manifest and corpus
missing, escaping, cache, bytecode, and duplicate paths are rejected
release classification requires clean source state
generated artifacts are explicitly non-authoritative projections

baselineComparison.before: project agent files and compiled context had no portable package contract
baselineComparison.after: a deterministic manifest and compiler bind governance, context, skills, adapters, provenance, and integrity

tradeoffs: the initial compiler accepts an explicit source list rather than discovering authority automatically
limitations: no external project package conformance run
reproduction: Run python3 tools/compile_package.py --config examples/agent-package/package-source.json --output examples/agent-package/output and python3 tools/validate.py.
